title: What That Goes Together Well
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 5 "neighbors swing new" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 6 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 7 "balance the ring" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 1 "partners balance and twirl to swap inside hands · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 2's partner is outside the group.
Row 3 "partners meltdown swing" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 2's partner is outside the group.
The progression after row 4 "robins do si do 1½ on right diagonal" doesn't work out: No couples meet new neighbors here.
choices: A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
